clinical_intent: A 60-year-old woman named Fatima has a recurrent cervical cancer after hysterectomy. The PET-CT shows a 3 cm pelvic sidewall recurrence adjacent to the left ureter. She has had prior EBRT of 50 Gy. The team is discussing re-irradiation with brachytherapy versus systemic chemotherapy. She is asking about the chances of cure versus palliation and what the treatment will be like. Address both the medical decision-making and the patient communication aspects.
